statusDefinitions.tested_case: The named test covers this individual requirement, not the whole topic.
statusDefinitions.known_missing: Gap requiring implementation and deterministic tests.
statusDefinitions.verified: Independently audited implementation and complete edge-case tests.

requirements.statement: One MP is spent per changed hexside; over-budget turns fail.

evidence.test: Facing changes cost one MP per hexside and reject over-budget or invalid turns

requirements.statement: A one-legged prone BattleMech can attempt to stand despite being unable to run.

evidence.test: A one-legged prone BattleMech may attempt to stand even though it cannot run (BMM p.45)

requirements.statement: Jumping into water uses the correct unmodified landing PSR.

evidence.test: Jump landing in water uses an unmodified PSR regardless of depth (BMM p.19)

requirements.statement: Head-aimed shots substitute the special targeting modifier for the immobile bonus.

evidence.test: Head aimed shot replaces immobile bonus with +3 (BMM p.30)

requirements.statement: Explicit ammunition-bin choices are honored when another shot uses shared ammo.

evidence.test: Automatic shared-ammo shot preserves a later explicitly reserved magazine (BMM ammo expenditure)

requirements.statement: Damage from a charge uses actual moved hexes.

evidence.test: Charge distance uses moved hexes, not shortest hex distance (BMM p.35)

requirements.statement: Physical attacks underwater deal halved damage.

evidence.test: Underwater punches, kicks and hatchet hits deal half damage rounded down (BMM pp.35,65)

requirements.statement: Head destruction is lethal to the pilot.

evidence.test: Head destruction kills the pilot rather than only disabling the unit (BMM p.44)

requirements.statement: Critical-hit transfer distinguishes the current phase from prior phases.

evidence.test: Last critical slot hit this phase does not transfer later criticals (BMM p.46)

requirements.statement: Internal ammunition explosions bypass external armor and wound the pilot.

evidence.test: Ammo explosion bypasses armor and wounds pilot twice

requirements.statement: Outside heat input is capped independently of self-generated heat.

evidence.test: External heat never exceeds 15 per turn even with repeated hits (BMM p.50)

requirements.statement: The initial involuntary reactor-shutdown PSR may succeed.

evidence.test: First involuntary reactor shutdown PSR can succeed (BMM p.52)

requirements.statement: Overheat ammunition-avoidance target numbers rise with heat.

evidence.test: Ammo explosion avoidance uses the highest heat threshold reached (BMM p.52)

requirements.statement: Each wound immediately updates and checks consciousness.

evidence.test: MechWarrior consciousness rolls increase after each wound (BMM p.58)

requirements.statement: Ammo being dumped is unavailable to fire but remains physically present.

evidence.test: Ammunition being dumped remains in the bin but cannot be fired (BMM p.58)

requirements.statement: Supported submerged weapons use rulebook underwater range brackets.

evidence.test: Underwater ranges match every supported BMM energy-weapon table row (p.65)

requirements.statement: Submerged hull damage can breach a location on a 10+ roll.

evidence.test: Underwater armor damage can breach a leg location on a roll of 10+ (BMM p.65)

requirements.statement: CASE prevents overflow transfer of internal explosion damage.

evidence.test: CASE vents an ammo explosion after RT is destroyed; pilot still suffers feedback (BMM p.47)

requirements.statement: Implement surface-dependent skid triggers and resolution.
Implement CASE II and its distinct containment behavior.
Implement AMS ammunition expenditure and interception resolution.
Implement ECM suppression and overlapping field interactions.
Implement targeting computer construction and aiming interactions.
Implement hidden-unit deployment, detection and reveal rules.
